exposure: detectable haptoglobin and haptoglobin-related protein (Hp&HpRP switch-on status) in cord blood
antenatal exposure to intra-amniotic infection and/or inflammation (IAI)
outcome: short-term outcomes until hospital discharge or death
cohort: The study included 185 singleton newborns delivered secondary to preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM).
finding: Newborns exposed antenatally to intra-amniotic infection and/or inflammation (IAI) had an increased risk of adverse neonatal outcome, while increasing gestational age and management with amniocentesis lowered this risk.
